channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: A rendição do Senado
item.description: The Brazilian Congress approved the overturning of the veto on the Dosimetry Bill, reducing penalties for those who attacked democracy on January 8, marking a symbolic victory for Bolsonarism. The image of Senator Davi Alcolumbre being embraced by Flávio Bolsonaro symbolized the Senate's surrender to a project favoring coup plotters, despite Lula's rejection of Jorge Messias for the Supreme Court. International press, including the Washington Post, warns this decision could overturn the 2026 elections and reveals a fragile relationship between the government and Congress.

item.title: Crise entre Planalto e presidente do Senado deixa a federação União-PP mais perto de apoiar Flávio
item.description: The rejection of Jorge Messias to the STF deepened the crisis between the Planalto and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, who has moved closer to Flávio Bolsonaro, Lula’s main presidential rival. Five months ahead of the 2026 elections, this tension raises the likelihood of União-PP backing Bolsonaro’s candidacy.

item.title: Entrevista: ‘Lula sabia do risco, e decisão de ir até o fim foi consciente ’, diz líder do governo sobre Messias
item.description: The government leader admitted that the rejection of Jorge Messias's nomination to the STJ by the Senate was anticipated, citing articulation difficulties in a Congress with a conservative majority and electoral calendar pressure. Despite internal optimistic projections of 43 to 45 favorable votes, the result was 34, reflecting an underestimation of Bolsonarist opposition, which controls around 35 senators. He stated he had warned Minister Messias and President Lula about the vote's unviability since November, but the decision to proceed was upheld by the majority of the base leaders.

item.title: Elio Gaspari: os saltos altos quebram
item.description: The nomination of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court (STF) was seen as the peak of PT influence in Lula 3.0, but his rejection marked the end of that dominance. The following day, the overturning of the dosimetry veto further weakened the STF’s position, signaling a shift in the balance of power. The subscriber-exclusive article frames this moment as the symbolic collapse of the 'high heel' of the petista establishment.

item.title: ‘O voto nos estados’: com segurança e privatizações no centro da revanche, Tarcísio e Haddad reeditam disputa em SP
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad are renewing their 2022 rivalry for the São Paulo governorship in 2026, centering the debate on Sabesp’s privatization and public security. A Genial/Quaest poll shows Tarcísio leading with 38% of voting intentions versus Haddad’s 26%, mirroring the 2022 gap. The Sabesp privatization, completed in June 2024, is framed by Tarcísio as an achievement and by Haddad as a source of public dissatisfaction, tied to rising complaints at Arsep and Procon.

item.title: Derrotas no Congresso estremecem base de Lula para tentativa de reeleição e testam relação entre Poderes
item.description: Seven months from the end of his third term, Lula faces his worst relationship with Congress, marked by tensions with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, threatening the approval of strategic agendas like ending the 6x1 work scale and the Public Security PEC. The government fears parliamentary retaliation, including the passage of 'bomb' bills, in a critical election year for his reelection bid.

item.title: Presiones de Trump, tretas partidistas y supresión del voto negro: la batalla sin cuartel por las elecciones de noviembre en EE UU
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court, with a conservative majority, struck down a Louisiana electoral district with a Black majority, further weakening the Voting Rights Act of 1965. The ruling opens the door to electoral rule changes in other Southern states that could favor the Republican Party by making it harder for Black citizens to vote.

item.title: Conservadorismo não é bolsonarismo
item.description: The text argues that conservatism in Brazil is an older, broader, and deeper political and intellectual tradition, while Bolsonarism is a recent, personalist political phenomenon centered on Jair Bolsonaro’s figure, rhetoric, method, and surrounding community. It criticizes the common conflation of the two as analytically flawed. The content is presented as exclusive subscriber material.

item.title: Ivan Valente se despede do Congresso e prega guinada de Lula à esquerda
item.description: Ivan Valente, a PSOL deputy, delivered his final speech in Congress on March 19, announcing his retirement at age 80 after eight terms. He denounced corruption among PL deputies, criticized 'elite lackeys,' and condemned figures like Flávio Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira, lamenting the decline of political discourse and the normalization of the January 8 coup attempt. His farewell reflected on the need for political renewal and his lifelong struggle against dictatorship and for the left.

item.title: Indicação de Messias foi ponto alto da onipotência petista, e saltos altos quebraram
item.description: The nomination of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court was seen as the peak of petista omnipotence during Lula 3.0. His rejection marked the moment when the government's perceived invincibility was broken, symbolized by a broken high heel. The following day, the overturning of the dosimetry veto represented another defeat, with the 'Supreme Court's heel' also breaking.

item.title: Lula testa mote para reeleição enquanto acumula tropeços no Congresso
item.description: President Lula (PT) is testing a campaign slogan for his 2026 re-election bid amid growing difficulties with Congress. Last week, he suffered two significant defeats, including the historic rejection of his Supreme Court nominee — the first since the late 19th century. These legislative setbacks complicate his agenda and increase pressure on his candidacy.

item.title: Moraes manda prender empresário que financiou bloqueio de rodovias
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered the arrest of businessman and pilot Willian Frederico Jaeger, sentenced to five years in prison for violently attempting to abolish the democratic state. He was accused of financing and participating in highway blockades in Santa Catarina in 2022 following the presidential election results, attacking federal police with an iron bar and using company resources to support protesters. The unanimous conviction by the STF’s 1st Chamber in December 2025 has become final and unappealable.

item.title: Wanessa Camargo entrega seu lado político em meio à polêmica do pai Zezé com SBT
item.description: Wanessa Camargo stated she avoids discussing politics with her father, Zezé di Camargo, despite his controversy with SBT over inviting STF ministers and Lula. She identifies as centrist, respecting her father while maintaining different opinions, and said she would support him if he ran for office, emphasizing his character and life journey.

item.title: Série D ZeroUm: confira os melhores momentos de ABC-RN x Central-PE. Vídeo
item.description: Metrópoles Esporte streamed the 1-1 draw between ABC-RN and Central-PE live in the 2026 Série D, 5th round, at Frasqueirão Stadium. The broadcast was part of 12 matches aired on Saturday, with seven more scheduled for Sunday and one on Monday. The outlet positions itself as Brazil's sports hub, covering various tournaments and events.

item.title: Messias publica montagem com IA e diz que “é preciso coragem”
item.description: Attorney General of the Union Jorge Messias posted an AI-generated montage on X following the Senate's rejection of his Supreme Court nomination, stating that 'courage is needed' to uphold unpopular principles. The episode marks the first Senate rejection of a presidential STF nominee in 132 years and intensifies the rift between the Executive and Legislative branches, underscoring the government's struggle to form a stable majority in Congress.

item.title: Lula diz que vai criar 41 praças para caminhoneiros “descansarem”
item.description: President Lula announced the government will create 41 rest areas for truckers by the end of 2026 during the second phase of the Move Brasil program. The program previously allocated R$10 billion in its first phase and will now provide an additional R$21.2 billion in credit for purchasing trucks, buses, and road equipment, with improved terms including lower interest rates and longer grace periods. Lula urged public banks to treat independent truckers with 'care,' emphasizing the government's commitment to those who 'move Brazil'.

item.title: Avatar de “Dona Maria”, alvo do PT no TSE, é usado para defender Lula
item.description: The PT, PV, and PCdoB filed a complaint with the TSE against the AI-generated profile 'Dona Maria', alleging it spreads disinformation and conducts illegal political propaganda against the Lula government. However, pro-Lula accounts used the same avatar just one day later to defend the president and attack the right, revealing a contradiction in the parties’ strategy. Active since 2025, the profile achieved high engagement, surpassing that of some real politicians, according to a BBC News Brasil report.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro defende reduzir maioridade penal para 14 anos
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) advocated for reducing Brazil's age of criminal responsibility to 14 years, particularly in rape cases, calling the measure urgent due to perceived impunity. He had previously supported increasing the maximum prison sentence to 80 years and linked his stance to a broader hardline on crime as part of his 2026 presidential pre-campaign. The proposal contrasts with current law, which considers those under 18 criminally inimputable, subjecting them to socioeducational measures under the ECA instead of the adult penal system.

item.title: Lula lamenta morte de Raimundo Rodrigues Pereira
item.description: President Lula mourned the death of journalist Raimundo Rodrigues Pereira, aged 85, praising his role in the fight for democracy and press freedom during the military dictatorship. Pereira was a key figure in Brazil's alternative press, serving as editor-in-chief of the weekly Opinião and founding the newspaper Movimento, in addition to working at O Estado de S. Paulo and the magazine Realidade.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro foi articulador e grande beneficiário das duas derrotas de Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro emerged as the main strategist and beneficiary of Lula’s two recent legislative defeats: the congressional override of the veto on the Dosimetry Bill and the rejection of Jorge Messias’ STF nomination. While Lula grappled with internal and external crises, Flávio solidified congressional backing—particularly from the Centrão—advanced in polls, and built state-level structures for a 2026 presidential run, despite looming family controversies.

item.title: Fux vota para absolver encanador condenado pelo 8/1
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Luiz Fux voted to acquit plumber Edinilson Felizardo da Silva, who was convicted for involvement in the January 8 attacks. Fux stated he changed his understanding from previous rulings, signaling a reassessment of his stance on the accountability of participants in the events.

item.title: Histórico desafia vaticínio de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro claimed that the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias for the STF marks the 'end of Lula's government', citing a break with over 130 years of tradition. However, the article notes that similar opposition predictions of Lula's political demise have failed in the past, including after the mensalão scandal and his imprisonment in the Lava-Jato operation, from which he returned to win the presidency in 2022. The piece urges caution, highlighting Lula's history of overcoming significant political setbacks.

item.title: Alcolumbre previu placar de derrota de Messias muito antes de áudio vazado
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre, Senate President, accurately predicted Jorge Messias' defeat in the STF nomination vote, stating he would lose by eight votes before the result was announced. The remark, accidentally picked up by a lapel microphone, exposed the disconnect between Lula's government and Senate leadership, as government allies were warned the outcome was irreversible. The fallout signals a deteriorating Executive-Legislative relationship, with Lula's allies now viewing the Senate as lost to government control and urging focus on electoral campaigns.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro defende redução da maioridade penal para 14 anos em casos de estupro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a senator and potential 2026 presidential candidate, advocated lowering Brazil's age of criminal responsibility to 14 years in rape cases, stating he authored a constitutional amendment (PEC) on the issue. He justified the proposal after claiming to have received a video of children being raped by attackers, four of whom were minors, and said he would push for its approval in Congress or implement it under his future administration if elected.

item.title: Vídeo com IA resgata Lula “raiz” capaz de superar “pedradas”
item.description: A video produced with AI assistance and shared on the 'Lula Gigante Oficial' Instagram page depicts President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva as a 'root' metalworker, emphasizing his journey of overcoming adversity. Created by publicist Edson Barbosa and featuring the PT logo, the video was released following two congressional defeats: the overturning of Lula’s veto on the Dosimetry Bill and the rejection of Jorge Messias’ STF nomination. It highlights Lula’s working-class origins, using imagery of factories, prison, and campaign speeches to evoke an emotional narrative rooted in the party’s struggle against inequality.

item.title: Para barrar dosimetria no STF, PT depende de sorteio
item.description: The PT seeks to block the Dosimetry Law at the Supreme Court through a legal action that will be randomly assigned to a justice, as there is no natural rapporteur. The outcome will depend on the drawn justice, who may deny the request, seek information from Congress, or refer the case to the full Court. However, the STF is expected to avoid a new confrontation with Congress, given recent tensions over issues like the secret budget and fake news investigations.

item.title: Rejuvenesça o Zema e devolva-o à maravilhosa infância produtiva
item.description: Romeu Zema defended the idea that children should be allowed to work during an interview on Labor Day, sparking controversy over the normalization of absurdity in political discourse. His presidential candidacy has already raised numerous questions, and now he challenges voters to reintroduce the exclamation mark into their habits, suggesting a radical shift in views on childhood and productivity.

item.title: A confusão na estreia do novo marqueteiro responsável pela campanha de Lula
item.description: The PT unveiled a campaign video created by its new strategist Raul Rabelo at its national congress, linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the Banco Master scandal by claiming he bought a Brasília mansion with diverted funds and using the term 'bolsomaster'. Intended for internal party viewing, the video was leaked by a journalist present at the event, prompting backlash from Bolsonaro allies who accuse the PT of spreading false information and have requested a PGR investigation.

item.title: O conselho equivocado de José Dirceu sobre as chances de Messias no Senado
item.description: On March 31, José Dirceu claimed Jorge Messias already had the 41 Senate votes needed for Supreme Court approval, a month before the nomination was rejected by 42 against and 34 in favor. Dirceu later admitted it was a 'grave political defeat', citing the lack of a governing majority in Congress and possible motives such as backlash over the January 8 rioters' convictions and the presidential race.

item.title: TCU arquiva caso de viagem de Nikolas em jatinho ligado a Vorcaro
item.description: The TCU archived a representation requesting an investigation into the use of a jet linked to businessman Daniel Vorcaro by Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) during the 2022 campaign, citing lack of evidence of public fund use and stating that electoral expense analysis falls under the Electoral Justice. The ruling, signed on April 25, 2026, referred the case to the TSE and the Electoral Public Prosecutor's Office.

item.title: O pleito da comunidade judaica ao TSE sobre as eleições presidenciais de outubro
item.description: Fábio Wajngarten will petition the TSE to change the date of the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election, currently set for October 4, as it coincides with Simchat Torah, a sacred Jewish holiday during which creative work and electricity use are prohibited. If changing the date is not feasible, he requests a special voting window for Jewish citizens from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM on Sunday to accommodate their religious observances.

item.title: Lula lamenta morte do jornalista Raimundo Pereira: "Nunca se calou"
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva mourned the death of journalist Raimundo Rodrigues Pereira, highlighting his resistance to the military dictatorship and his commitment to press freedom and union struggles. Lula called him the 'first to show, at the national level, what the struggle for union rights and freedom meant' and emphasized that he 'never kept silent,' even under persecution and imprisonment. Raimundo Pereira founded the newspaper Movimento in 1975, worked for outlets like O Estado de S. Paulo and Veja, and was involved in the dossier that denounced torture under the Médici government in 1969.

item.title: Justiça nega pedido para retirar do ar postagem do deputado Nikolas Ferreira sobre Janja e Lula
item.description: The 6th Special Civil Court of Brasília denied an urgent request to remove a social media post by Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) that mentioned President Lula and First Lady Janja. Judge Júlio César Lérias Ribeiro found no evidence of transphobia or hate speech in the post, despite the politically polarized context. The case remains active, with a conciliation hearing scheduled for May 25.

item.title: Defesa de Débora do Batom pede redução de pena após Congresso derrubar vetos do PL da Dosimetria
item.description: The defense of Débora Rodrigues dos Santos, known as 'Débora do batom', has asked Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to reduce her 14-year sentence based on the approval of the Dosimetry Bill by Congress, which overturned the presidential veto and revised penalty calculation rules for crimes related to the January 8 events. Lawyers argue the new law allows for a sentence reduction of one-third to two-thirds and immediate progression to semi-open regime, as Débora has nearly fulfilled the time requirement for benefit, expected by June 9, 2026.

item.title: Governador defende que Lula volte a indicar Jorge Messias ao STF
item.description: Piauí Governor Rafael Fonteles (PT) urged President Lula to renominate Attorney General Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court (STF). He stated that Wednesday’s Senate vote allowed for two conclusions, though the full statement was not disclosed in the excerpt. The move aims to strengthen the government’s presence in the STF.

item.title: Haddad quer debater economia com Tarcísio e aposta em ‘inflação São Paulo’ para desgastar governador
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) aims to center the São Paulo electoral debate on the economy, appealing to voters' wallets by highlighting 'São Paulo inflation' through fare hikes in public transport, water, and tolls under Tarcísio de Freitas' (Republicanos) administration. Despite Tarcísio's lead in polls, Haddad's allies argue his governance has vulnerabilities in cost of living, citing a 22.73% increase in metro and train fares since 2023 and water bill hikes following Sabesp's privatization as key attack points.

item.title: A toga que não veio
item.description: The nomination of Jorge Messias to the STF was rejected by the Senate in a surprising vote of 42 against 34, delivering a defeat to Lula’s government. Senator Soraya Thronicke’s comment about 'putting on the robe' was seen as a premonition of the outcome, sparking widespread social media reaction. The decision reflected discomfort with Messias’ positions, particularly his defense of fetal cardiostop after 22 weeks of gestation, alongside political maneuvering and public opinion pressure.

item.title: Nikolas reage após TCU arquivar ação sobre voos em jatinho de Vorcaro
item.description: Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) welcomed the TCU's dismissal of a representation questioning the source of funds used for flights on a jet owned by banker Daniel Vorcaro during the 2022 electoral campaign. TCU minister Antonio Anastasia ruled that the matter falls under the jurisdiction of the TSE, as it pertains to campaign financing, leading to the case being archived. Nikolas stated the dismissal was 'yet another narrative that fell apart' and affirmed he has done nothing wrong.

item.title: Governador do Piauí defende nova indicação de Messias ao STF
item.description: The governor of Piauí, Rafael Fonteles (PT), advocated for the re-nomination of Attorney General Jorge Messias to the STF following his rejection by the Senate on April 29, 2026. He praised Messias’s performance during the confirmation hearing and stressed the need to preserve Northeastern representation and high judicial quality on the Court, calling the defeat a political setback for President Lula.

item.title: Flávio visita Anderson Torres na Papudinha
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro visited former Justice Minister Anderson Torres at Papudinha in Brasília on Saturday, the 2nd. In a social media post, Flávio advocated for amnesty for those involved in the January 8, 2023 events and described Torres as a 'victim of persecution'.

item.title: TCU arquiva representação sobre voos de Nikolas em jatinho de Vorcaro
item.description: The TCU archived a representation requesting an investigation into Deputy Nikolas Ferreira’s flights on a jet owned by banker Daniel Vorcaro, ruling that the matter pertains to campaign finance and thus falls under the jurisdiction of the Electoral Justice (TSE), not the audit court. Relator Minister Antonio Anastasia stated that the technical-contractual analysis of campaign expenses is exclusively the responsibility of the Electoral Justice. Ferreira celebrated the decision, saying "another narrative that fell apart".

item.title: Lula deveria deixar política após “facada” de aliados, diz Zé de Abreu
item.description: Actor José de Abreu urged President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva to retire from politics following the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias's STF nomination, which he described as a 'backstab' by an unnamed ally, likely Jaques Wagner. Abreu suggested Lula should enjoy retirement giving speeches and traveling, escaping the 'rotten politics'. The rejection also drew criticism from left-wing deputies Erika Hilton, Gleisi Hoffmann, and Guilherme Boulos, who condemned the Congress as an enemy of the people and lamented the loss of a qualified STF candidate.

item.title: Vídeo pede que Lula não se abale frente às adversidades
item.description: A video shared on Instagram shows urban and rural workers defending President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, urging him not to be shaken by adversity. The content reinforces popular support for the government amid political and economic challenges.

item.title: Defesa de ‘Débora do Batom’ pede ao STF redução da pena com base no PL da Dosimetria
item.description: The defense of Débora Rodrigues dos Santos, known as 'Débora do Batom', is asking the STF to reduce her 14-year sentence based on the approval of the Dosimetria Bill by Congress, which overrode the presidential veto. The law is not yet in force, awaiting promulgation by President Lula, and its benefits will not be automatic, subject to judicial review. She was convicted for her role in the January 8, 2023 anti-democratic acts, including graffitiing the Justice statue with the phrase 'Perdeu, mané'.

item.title: Flávio nega acordo entre oposição e Moraes por CPI do Master
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) denied any agreement between opposition lawmakers and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to block the Banco Master CPI, stating that coinciding legislative priorities — not negotiations — explained recent votes. He asserted the CPI will proceed and that opposition pressure will continue, dismissing reports by journalists like Malu Gaspar as based on wrong sources. He also criticized the Lula government for political weakness, rising debt and taxes, and labeled proposals such as ending the 6×1 work scale as populist and election-driven.

item.title: Zema diz que criança vai poder trabalhar, caso seja eleito presidente
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor and Novo presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema defended child labor on Workers' Day, arguing that children should be allowed to perform simple tasks, citing the U.S. example of kids delivering newspapers. He criticized the left's view that work harms children and pledged to change this stance if elected president.

item.title: Boulos chama Zema de “psicopata” após fala sobre trabalho infantil
item.description: Minister Guilherme Boulos (Psol-SP) criticized former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) for advocating the relaxation of child labor laws, calling his remarks 'serious signs of being a psychopath'. Zema had compared Brazil to the U.S., suggesting children could perform simple tasks like delivering newspapers if education remained a priority. PT deputies also condemned the proposal, emphasizing that Brazil has overcome 350 years of slavery and should not reintroduce child labor exploitation.

item.title: Governador do Piauí defende que Lula reapresente Messias ao Senado para o STF
item.description: Piauí Governor Rafael Fonteles urged President Lula to renominate Jorge Messias to the STF, praising his qualifications demonstrated during the April 29 hearing. Despite the Senate's rejection of Messias by a 42-34 vote due to Senate Rule 1 of 2020, which bars re-voting on a rejected nominee in the same legislative session, Fonteles stressed the need for Executive-Legislative coordination to prevent harm to the Northeast and avoid losing a highly competent justice.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro visita Anderson Torres na Papuda
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro visited former Justice Minister Anderson Torres at the 19th Military Police Battalion in Brasília, on the occasion of Torres' wife's birthday, stating Torres is a victim of persecution over the January 8 events. He reiterated his commitment to total amnesty for those involved, calling the legal processes a 'farce of an attempted coup'. The visit followed Congress overturning President Lula's veto on the Dosimetria Bill, which reduces penalties for state coup crimes and benefits Bolsonaro and 849 others convicted in the January 8 attacks.

item.title: Bolsonaro apresenta boa evolução de cirurgia no ombro
item.description: Former president Jair Bolsonaro is showing good post-surgical recovery following shoulder surgery performed in Brasília on April 1, 2026, with no complications. He remains hospitalized at DF Star Hospital under thrombosis prevention measures and will begin motor and functional rehabilitation. The surgery was authorized by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, within the framework of Bolsonaro’s humanitarian house arrest stemming from his conviction in the coup plot case.
